skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, benefits, and stages of e-government development. Be able to analyze and solve practical issues related to e-government.
Understand the role of e-government in public administration and its application in various government activities.
Analyze and evaluate data and information related to e-government services.
Plan and implement e-government projects, including policy formulation and technology application.
Communicate effectively in both individual and group settings, presenting and discussing e-government topics.
Apply critical thinking to identify and solve problems related to e-government services.
Work effectively in teams, contributing to group projects and presentations.
Develop independent learning skills and the ability to research and understand e-government topics.
Understand ethical and social responsibilities in e-government and business contexts.
Utilize digital tools and platforms for e-government transactions and services.

prerequisite_courses: Thương mại điện tử căn bản
